transcript.content: Hello. What brings you in to see me today?

Hi. Um, I'm here because lately I just can't seem to keep my head clear at work. I keep losing track of what my clients are saying to me. I'll sit there and reread the same chart note over and over again, and then I just... I freeze up on really simple decisions that I used to handle without a problem. It's just getting really hard to do my job right now.
Aside from the trouble focusing, have you been feeling down, depressed, or hopeless lately?

I'm not really sure. I haven't really noticed feeling sad or hopeless, to be honest. It's mostly just been the trouble focusing at work that's bothering me right now. I haven't really thought about it beyond that.
Have you been feeling unusually anxious, nervous, or on edge lately?

No, I wouldn't say I feel anxious. Um, I haven't noticed feeling nervous or on edge at all. It really is just the trouble concentrating and making decisions that I mentioned earlier. I don't feel panicky or anything like that.
How has your sleep been lately?

It hasn't been great, honestly. I'll get home from work feeling really tired, but then I just... I lie in bed for hours. I end up just replaying the day in my head. And then, if I do finally manage to fall asleep, I wake up way before my alarm goes off. I just wake up feeling like I barely slept at all.
Have you noticed a loss of interest or pleasure in things you usually enjoy doing?

Yeah, actually, I have. Um, my guitar has just been sitting in the corner for a while now. I keep bailing on soccer and my shifts at the shelter. And even when I force myself to try to do things I usually like, like cooking or going hiking, it just feels like... I don't know, like I'm just going through the motions. It just feels like there's no real point to it.
Have you ever had a period in your life before this where you experienced similar difficulties with your sleep, focus, or loss of interest?

No, I don't think so. I mean, I've had normal days in the past where I was just tired or didn't feel like doing much, but... no, nothing like this. This is really the first time I've ever felt this way, where it just doesn't go away.
Did a specific stressful event or major change in your life happen around the time these difficulties started?

Yeah, actually. It's been going on for about a month now. The clinic where I work lost some staff, so my schedule got shifted around. I'm doing late-evening coverage now, and I've had to take on a lot heavier crisis paperwork. So... yeah, that's right around the time all this started.
Have you noticed any changes in your appetite or your weight recently?

Yeah, I have. Um, most days I don't really feel hungry at all. It's like I don't even think about eating until someone reminds me to. And, well, I've noticed my pants have gotten pretty loose lately, just from skipping meals without really meaning to.
Have you been feeling unusually fatigued or lacking in energy lately?

Yeah, definitely. I just... I don't have any energy at all. It's like, even just doing the small stuff—showering, driving over to the clinic, or just trying to get through a single stack of paperwork—it feels like I'm dragging around a backpack full of bricks. Everything just takes so much effort now.
